item.title: J&K and Ladakh HC issues notice on PIL seeking ST Status, Pahari Speaking People certificates for PoJK Displaced Persons of 1947
item.description: “The President of Jammu Kashmir Sharnarthi Action Committee which raised voice for the displaced persons was aggrieved by the unjust treatment meted out to the DPs of 1947 who were illegally displaced from PoJK, particularly regarding their recognition as Scheduled Tribe under Pahari Ethnic Group and issuance of a PSP Certificate.” The post J&K and Ladakh HC issues notice on PIL seeking ST Status, Pahari Speaking People certificates for PoJK Displaced Persons of 1947 appeared first on SCC Times.

item.title: Security deposit in lease agreement not “debt” under RDDBFI Act: Punjab and Haryana High Court
item.description: “Once security deposit does not fall within the purview of Section 2(g) of the Recovery of Debts due to the Banks and Financial Institution Act, 1993 defining “debt”, the Tribunal would have no jurisdiction, as per Section 17 of the same Act.” The post Security deposit in lease agreement not “debt” under RDDBFI Act: Punjab and Haryana High Court appeared first on SCC Times.
